name: Doral
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Doral, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Doral, FL: a holiday train and lights at Doral Central Park, Elf Factory workshops, Santa at CityPlace and a Main Street fiesta.
lede: Doral does Christmas with a Latin beat: a city party in Doral Central Park with rides and Santa photos, a Christmas market on Downtown Doral's Main Street and carnival afternoons at CityPlace Doral.
celebrates: The City of Doral opens the season with a Park and Tree Lighting Ceremony at Downtown Doral Park, where the newest ceremony switched on a brand-new 40-foot holiday tree and lit up the Government Center. In December the city throws its big family party at Doral Central Park, with carnival rides, a snow slide and photos with Santa. Downtown Doral brings El Mercado Navideño and Latin American music to Main Street, CityPlace Doral hosts a holiday carnival with Santa and Nutcracker characters, and the Elf Factory pop-up at CityPlace fills with kids making slime, ornaments and letters to Santa.
lastyear: In 2025 the City of Doral's Holiday Celebration at the Park was planned for Saturday, December 6, from 4 to 8 pm at Doral Central Park. Entry was free, with carnival rides, inflatables, a snow tubing slide and face painting. Photos with Santa were $5 per print and an unlimited rides wristband cost $10. CityPlace Doral planned its Holiday of Miracles Winter Carnival for December 11, with free Santa photos and a toy drive for Jackson Health Foundation.
facts: Doral is named after a couple. In the late 1950s, Doris and Alfred Kaskel bought 2,400 acres of swampland for about $49,000 and in 1962 opened a hotel and country club they named Doral, a mix of Doris and Alfred. Families arrived in the 1980s, when there were still farms with cows, horses and chickens along NW 107th Avenue. In January 2003, 85 percent of voters chose to make Doral a city.
trains: Doral sits next to the western end of Metrorail. The Green Line ends at Palmetto station, 7701 NW 79th Avenue, on the edge of Doral, and the Miami International Airport station at the Miami Intermodal Center, 3800 NW 25th Street, connects the Orange Line with Tri-Rail. Brightline leaves from MiamiCentral in downtown Miami. For a train day, the Gold Coast Railroad Museum in Miami has the presidential car Ferdinand Magellan and a narrow gauge train ride.
train_links: More than 40 historic rail cars, the presidential car Ferdinand Magellan and a narrow gauge train ride in Miami.
traditions: The City of Doral lights its holiday tree at Downtown Doral Park and illuminates the Government Center to start the season.
Holiday party at Doral Central Park
The city's December celebration brings carnival rides, a snow slide, inflatables and photos with Santa to Doral Central Park.
Downtown Doral's Christmas market fills Main Street with vendors and live Latin American music.
CityPlace Doral hosts an afternoon with Santa, carnival games, popcorn and a dance party with elves and Nutcracker characters.
A Christmas pop-up at CityPlace Doral where kids make slime, ornaments and crafts and write a Letter to Santa.
kidfact: Doral got its name from two people. Doris and Alfred Kaskel squished their first names together, Dor plus Al, and named their golf club Doral. Later the whole city took the name.
faq: Where does Doral hold its big Christmas party?

The City of Doral holds its main December celebration at Doral Central Park, 3005 NW 92nd Avenue. In recent years it has offered free entry with paid extras: in 2025 the city charged $5 per printed Santa photo and $10 for an unlimited rides wristband, and parking inside the park needed a separate pass.
Where is the Doral tree lighting?

The City of Doral holds its Park and Tree Lighting Ceremony at Downtown Doral Park, 8395 NW 53rd Street, in late November. The ceremony lights the holiday tree and the nearby Government Center, and the city's newest ceremony introduced a brand-new 40-foot holiday tree.
Is there a Christmas market in Doral?

Yes. Downtown Doral runs El Mercado Navideño on its pedestrian Main Street as part of a free holiday fiesta, with Latin American music, a giant Christmas tree and family activities. The city's park celebration and the CityPlace Doral carnival also include holiday markets with local vendors.
Where can kids make Christmas crafts in Doral?

Elf Factory, a Christmas pop-up at CityPlace Doral, runs 60-minute workshops for children from age 2. Kids mix slime, decorate squishies, make ornaments and crafts such as wooden nutcrackers, and write a Letter to Santa. In its first season, 2025, it reported more than 1,100 workshop seats filled.
Which train stations are near Doral?

Metrorail's Green Line ends at Palmetto station, 7701 NW 79th Avenue, on Doral's edge. The Miami International Airport station at the Miami Intermodal Center, 3800 NW 25th Street, links Metrorail's Orange Line and Tri-Rail. Brightline trains leave from MiamiCentral in downtown Miami, a short Metrorail ride away.
